brief: 5 SaaS categories AI agents are killing in 2026 — and what to build instead.

slots.title: 1. Airtable, the organizer
slots.body: Static grids and manual tagging become obsolete. Build autonomous context engines that ingest conversations, update records, and surface insights without human data entry.

slots.title: 2. Zapier, the connector
slots.body: Pre-defined zaps break when agents need to reason. Build agentic orchestration that negotiates APIs, handles retries, and self-heals without hardcoded paths.

slots.title: 3. Slack, the distractor
slots.body: Channel noise and manual updates drain productivity. Build agent-to-agent protocols that resolve issues, schedule actions, and only ping humans for exceptions.

slots.title: 4. Loom, the recorder
slots.body: Recording your screen for every explanation does not scale. Build on-demand synthetic video agents that generate personalized walkthroughs from a single prompt.

slots.title: 5. Linear, the tracker
slots.body: Backlog grooming and manual status checks slow teams. Build execution backplanes that auto-delegate tasks, verify deliverables, and reprioritize based on live context.

slots.title: 6. You, the orchestrator
slots.body: The winners in 2026 do not sell seats. Sell agent infrastructure: memory, auth, tool-use, and verifiable outcomes that replace entire SaaS categories.
